name: H2-VQE Topology Benchmark
description: Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design benchmark for molecular H2 VQE ground-state energy estimation on superconducting heavy-hex architectures. Eliminates 100% of physical SWAP routing (0 SWAPs), achieving chemical accuracy via Zero-Noise Extrapolation. Developed for Qiskit Fall Hackathon 2026 (SRM AP) by Rishendra & Team.
